places: Mt. Fogo (a volcano on Fogo Island)

fields.climate: temperate; warm, dry summer; precipitation meager and erratic
fields.hazards: prolonged droughts; seasonal harmattan wind produces obscuring dust; volcanically and seismically active; volcanism: Fogo (2,829 m), which last erupted in 1995, is Cabo Verde's only active volcano
fields.resources: salt, basalt rock, limestone, kaolin, fish, clay, gypsum
fields.farm: sugarcane, tomatoes, coconuts, pulses, goat milk, milk, vegetables, bananas, cabbages, onions
fields.exports: fish, refined petroleum, railway cargo containers, shellfish, garments
fields.industries: food and beverages, fish processing, shoes and garments, salt mining, ship repair
fields.languages: Portuguese (official), Crioulo (a Portuguese-based creole language with two main dialects)
fields.religions: Roman Catholic 72.5%, Protestant 4% (includes Adventist 1.9%, Nazarene 1.8%, Assembly of God 0.2%, God is Love 0.1%), Christian Rationalism 1.7%, Muslim 1.3%, Jehovah's Witness 1.2%, Church of Jesus…
fields.military: 17 years of age for voluntary service (with parental consent); 18-35 years of age for selective compulsory service (14-month service obligation)
